title: Open Mic @ New Moon Bar & Grill
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring all genres of music in a lively bar and grill atmosphere. Musicians can perform covers or original material. This event welcomes singers and instrumentalists of all skill levels.
event_venue_information:
About New Moon Bar & Grill

New Moon Bar & Grill is Montgomery's go-to late-night destination combining great food with live entertainment. This family-friendly venue attracts a diverse crowd from college students to families seeking quality dining and nightlife.

The Venue Experience

Known for its energetic atmosphere and attentive service New Moon features a full bar with craft cocktails and an extensive food menu. The venue is famous for their perfectly seasoned chicken wings and the celebrated Moon Burger. Live DJs regularly set the mood creating an upbeat environment for guests.

Music and Events

New Moon hosts regular open mic nights on Thursdays giving local musicians a platform to showcase their talents. The venue welcomes various music genres and provides PA system support for performers. Beyond open mics the space hosts special themed events and live music performances throughout the year.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The venue operates late hours making it Montgomery's unofficial after-hours kitchen. With neon lights and good energy the space provides a welcoming environment where musicians cool off after sets and patrons enjoy quality food and drinks well into the night. The attentive staff and diverse drink selection keep the atmosphere lively and engaging.
